parameters.name: backendServiceName
parameters.description: The backend service name. You can use this name to filter routes.

parameters.name: consumerAuthorizationRuleId
parameters.description: Filters the API list by a specific consumer authorization rule ID. The response includes only authorized APIs.

parameters.name: deployStatuses
parameters.description: The deployment status of the route.

parameters.name: domainId
parameters.description: The domain name ID used to filter route information.

parameters.name: forDeploy
parameters.description: Specifies whether this is a deployment scenario.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number, starting from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: withAuthPolicyInfo
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include consumer authorization information in the response.

parameters.name: withConsumerInfoById
parameters.description: Specifies a consumer ID so that the response includes the authorization rule list for the specified consumer in each route.

parameters.name: withPluginAttachmentByPluginId
parameters.description: Specifies a plug-in ID so that the response includes the mount information of the specified plug-in in each route.
